CREATE INDEX ix_paper_s2_id ON paper (s2_id)

CREATE INDEX ix_recommendation_paper_id ON recommendation (paper_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_recommendationbatch_week_start ON recommendationbatch (week_start)

CREATE INDEX ix_statusevent_paper_id ON statusevent (paper_id)

CREATE TABLE achievement (
	code VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	unlocked_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (code)
)

CREATE TABLE embedding (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	paper_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	model VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	vector BLOB, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (paper_id, model), 
	FOREIGN KEY(paper_id) REFERENCES paper (id)
)

CREATE TABLE examplechoice (
	paper_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (paper_id, kind), 
	FOREIGN KEY(paper_id) REFERENCES paper (id)
)

CREATE TABLE ingestrun (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	library_id INTEGER, 
	mode VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	format VARCHAR, 
	source VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	file_name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	size INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	entries INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	added INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	updated INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	removed INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"check" JSON, 
	warnings JSON, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE library (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	format VARCHAR, 
	source_path VARCHAR, 
	use_for_recommendations BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE librarypaper (
	library_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	paper_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	citation_key VARCHAR, 
	folders JSON, 
	tags JSON, 
	added_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (library_id, paper_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(library_id) REFERENCES library (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(paper_id) REFERENCES paper (id)
)

CREATE TABLE notefile (
	paper_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	path VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	mtime_ns INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	size INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	meta VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	"conflict" BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	synced_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (paper_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(paper_id) REFERENCES paper (id)
)

CREATE TABLE paper (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	bibtex_key VARCHAR, 
	entry_type VARCHAR, 
	doi VARCHAR, 
	pmid VARCHAR, 
	pmcid VARCHAR, 
	arxiv_id VARCHAR, 
	s2_id VARCHAR, 
	openalex_id VARCHAR, 
	title VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	abstract VARCHAR, 
	authors JSON, 
	year INTEGER, 
	pub_date DATE, 
	venue VARCHAR, 
	venue_openalex_id VARCHAR, 
	url VARCHAR, 
	tldr VARCHAR, 
	citation_count INTEGER, 
	influential_citation_count INTEGER, 
	fwci FLOAT, 
	citation_percentile FLOAT, 
	venue_mean_citedness FLOAT, 
	topics JSON, 
	in_library BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	folders JSON, 
	tags JSON, 
	resolved_via VARCHAR, 
	enriched_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE profile (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	rules JSON, 
	fingerprint VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	app_version VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE queueitem (
	paper_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	position INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	added_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	reordered BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (paper_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(paper_id) REFERENCES paper (id)
)

CREATE TABLE reading (
	paper_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(9) NOT NULL, 
	rating INTEGER, 
	notes VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (paper_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(paper_id) REFERENCES paper (id)
)

CREATE TABLE recommendation (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	batch_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	paper_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	rank INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(4) NOT NULL, 
	score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	breakdown JSON, 
	reason VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(batch_id) REFERENCES recommendationbatch (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(paper_id) REFERENCES paper (id)
)

CREATE TABLE recommendationbatch (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	week_start DATE NOT NULL, 
	n_candidates INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	warnings JSON, 
	funnel JSON, 
	params JSON, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE statusevent (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	paper_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(9) NOT NULL, 
	was_queue_top BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	earlier BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	read_on DATE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(paper_id) REFERENCES paper (id)
)

CREATE TABLE xpevent (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	paper_id INTEGER, 
	points INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(paper_id) REFERENCES paper (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_paper_bibtex_key ON paper (bibtex_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_paper_doi ON paper (doi)
